# ARENQ brand artwork

Investor Desk's fixed INVESTOR, DESK and ID artwork was typeset from Arenq, designed by **Paulo R (skomii), 2014**. The artwork preserves the original default uppercase glyph outlines and spacing. The SVG rendering uses a small optical stroke so the thin outlines remain visible at compact sizes.

Original author distribution: https://www.dafont.com/arenq.font (downloaded September 12, 2026). The original notice grants free personal and commercial use; it is preserved verbatim in [arenq-license.txt](arenq-license.txt). This is not an OFL font.

Source OTF SHA-256: 9cb5ccda0a0d5715c409df09758b1211e408646952ac6ebae8b8bfa3fe0706a3. CoreText shaped only the three fixed brand strings at 1000 units/em; CGPath outlines were exported with coordinates rounded to 0.001 unit. The general font program is not installed, embedded, converted, subsetted, or distributed with the application. Its embedding flags were not altered.

The component's HTML text preserves accessible names and search/heading semantics. Body, table and numeric typefaces are unchanged.
